descFull: Beta. Self-hosted panel for running a VPN for others: family, friends, a community or a small team. Hysteria2, VLESS REALITY and AmneziaWG, one link per person. Add servers from the browser over SSH; client-eye health checks and Telegram alerts; MCP for AI agents. Two static Go binaries, SQLite, no Docker.
